checks.name: stock_physical_reconciles_with_ledger
checks.description: Every balance's physical qty equals the sum of its ledger qty_delta

checks.name: stock_blocked_reconciles_with_ledger
checks.description: Every balance's blocked qty equals the sum of its ledger blocked_delta

checks.name: stock_reserved_reconciles_with_active_reservations
checks.description: Every balance's reserved qty equals the sum of its ACTIVE reservations

checks.name: no_negative_or_overreserved_stock
checks.description: No balance is negative, and reserved + blocked never exceeds physical (available >= 0)

checks.name: reservations_only_on_released_unexpired_batches_or_were_valid_when_made
checks.description: No ACTIVE reservation sits on a REJECTED batch

checks.name: ledger_has_no_duplicate_document_postings
checks.description: No (source, line, leg, movement) appears twice in the ledger

checks.name: no_duplicate_goods_receipts
checks.description: No supplier delivery note is booked twice, and each goods receipt has exactly one idempotency key

checks.name: every_idempotency_key_has_at_most_one_effect
checks.description: Each (scope,key) is unique and every completed receipt key points at an existing goods receipt

checks.name: po_received_quantities_reconcile_with_receipts
checks.description: PO line qty_received equals the sum of goods-receipt line quantities and never exceeds qty_ordered

checks.name: every_receipt_line_is_in_the_ledger_with_matching_quantity
checks.description: Each goods-receipt line has exactly one RECEIPT ledger row of equal quantity

checks.name: batch_and_supplier_lot_traceability_intact
checks.description: Every received batch points back to its goods receipt, supplier and item; no ledger row references a missing batch

checks.name: every_goods_receipt_and_po_approval_has_an_audit_entry
checks.description: Committed business documents have their audit rows

checks.name: every_goods_receipt_has_an_outbox_event
checks.description: Each committed goods receipt produced its outbox event

checks.name: outbox_events_are_published_or_flagged
checks.description: No outbox event is dead (needs investigation) and none is stuck unpublished for > 5 minutes

checks.name: consumer_effects_are_not_duplicated
checks.description: At most one notification per (event, kind) and one dedupe marker per (consumer, event)

checks.name: ledger_is_append_only_by_construction
checks.description: Ledger rows carry the reversal link only once (a movement is reversed at most once)

skipped.name: accounting_journals_balanced
skipped.reason: Accounts module (double-entry ledger) is not implemented yet; check will be added with it
